summary.text: Greg Abbott is the Republican Governor of Texas, first elected in 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022. He previously served as Texas Attorney General (2002–2015) and as a justice of the Texas Supreme Court (1996–2001). As governor he signed the state's education savings account (school choice) law, permitless handgun carry, and a 2025 law restricting abortion-inducing drugs.

paragraphs.text: Abbott was born in Wichita Falls, Texas, and raised in Duncanville.
He graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a business degree and earned a law degree from Vanderbilt University.
He served as a state district judge in Harris County before joining the Supreme Court of Texas, to which he was appointed in 1996 and on which he served until 2001.
Abbott was elected attorney general in 2002 and held the office until 2015.
He took office as governor in January 2015, and he chaired the Republican Governors Association from November 2019 to December 2020.
